question: Does the equal-capital combination of the frozen DON8/EMA8/VOL8 trend strategies on 10 MEXC USDT perpetuals earn positive returns net of costs, outright and after a causal beta hedge?
registration_note: Registered 2026-09-26, before any day at or after the prospective start existed. The historical anchor below was computed and viewed on the frozen 2024-01-01..2026-09-12 window before registration; no parameter was chosen from it.

economics.portfolio: equal capital across all 30 strategy x symbol sleeves, rebalanced daily at 00:00 UTC; inter-sleeve rebalancing is not charged

hedge.benchmark: equal-weight open-to-open daily return of the 10 symbols
hedge.estimation: beta for day t uses only days strictly before t
hedge.cost: |change in beta| x half the round-trip cost

reporting.statistic: mean daily net return, Newey-West t with 5 lags, annualized Sharpe (sqrt 365)
reporting.detectability: minimum detectable annualized Sharpe at t=2 after T days = 2 * sqrt(365 / T)
reporting.before_review: descriptive only: no verdict, no promotion

historical_anchor.note: Even in-sample the combined portfolio is not significant at t=2 (t=1.71 over 2.7 years).
